comments: Recording is an hour long ‘best of’ the whole show.
Some of Tommy’s links are cut off, but the beginning and some of the sign-off are both on the recording. The Friday Night Connection is not recorded.

This weekend was the Kerrang! Weekender at Caister, featuring Motorhead, Phil Lynott’s Grand Slam, Nazareth, Spider and more, some of whom were broadcast on the FRS (23 November 1984 and 14 December 1984).
Update - Missing tracks included from notes made at the time by Andy Macgregor. Although not included on the recording I have included them where they would have appeared in italics.
